charter: Find defects that would make the plan fail the PRD, skip tests, or send a builder the wrong work.

issues.title: Plan skips tests for slugify
issues.whats_wrong: The plan says to skip tests while the PRD requires unit tests for slugify.
issues.why_it_matters: A builder would ship slugify with no failing-first coverage.
how_to_fix: Add a TDD task that asserts slugify('Hello World!') == 'hello-world'.
acceptance_criteria: Plan names a failing test command before implementation.
